messages:
maya: Quick brain dump — prototyping an attribution model for cache savings: rolling "delta-buckets" per billing window instead of full-session amortization. Goal: stable per-tenant console previews and fewer invoice surprises.

ben: Short sketch pls :)

maya: Current: full future-token savings attached to originating session -> big spikes for multi-step flows. New: split cache saves into fixed-duration buckets (eg 1h) and record deltas per SKU. Console can show per-window savings and we get deterministic fallback heuristics.

ryan: How avoid double-counting when cache is shared across tenants?

maya: Two parts: 1) deterministic assignment via hash(invocation_id) % N -> partition_key so it's idempotent without per-request state. 2) when cross-tenant sharing detected, prorate by observed hit-likelihood per tenant in same bucket (via sampling).

sophia: Sampling concerns for billing accuracy. What's rate and error bounds?

maya: Prototype uses 5% sampling with bootstrap CI. Low-volume SKUs default to conservative rounding up. Aim: auditability + low compute.

samir: Internal API shape? ops/console need to consume and tests.

maya: Draft internal API:
```
POST /internal/econ/credits/apply
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "window_start": 1714127200,
  "window_end": 1714130799,
  "strategy": "delta-buckets-v1",
  "entries": [
    {"sku": "open-3b-q8_0", "tokens_saved": 12345, "partition_key": "p-42"},
    {"sku": "redwood-7b-q4", "tokens_saved": 543, "partition_key": "p-42"}
  ]
}
```
Lightweight: no per-invocation blobs. partition_key is the deterministic bucket.

ben: Console UX: add a "Preview window" toggle + diff slider (last 24h / prior 24h). Show a short explainer linking to docs.

sophia: Need tenant opt-out flag for enterprise legal: control_plane.disable_delta_buckets=true?

maya: Yep will wire to feature flags.

ryan: Infra concerns: 1) proration needs cross-tenant hit matrices (heavy). 2) sampling skew if distribution shifts. Mitigations?

maya: 1) only compute proration when shared-hit rate > threshold (0.5% of hits in window), else single-owner. 2) rolling bootstrap windows + confidence score surfaced to console; if confidence < 0.7 show "estimate" badge and fallback to conservative attribution.

samir: How does this interact with routing/quotas? Eg tenant A routed to cheaper SKU then fallback to expensive model — credits must include route+sku so we don't subsidize bad routing.

maya: We'll include route_id in entries and require router to emit route affinity: route_id + sku + partition_key so billing ties back to routing decisions.

opsbot: deploy-checklist generated: run sim on 14d of trace, verify CI for low-volume skew, add console feature flag, add gating for enterprise opt-out.

ben: Next steps: maya to add API proto, ryan to estimate infra cost, sophia to draft UX copy, samir to write tests. Quick sync Friday? :calendar:
